start.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `bfloat16`, `float32`, `float64`. N-D tensor. First entry in the range.
constraints: start must be one of bfloat16, float32, float64

stop.description: A `Tensor`. Must have the same type and shape as `start`. N-D tensor. Last entry in the range.

num.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `int64`. 0-D tensor. Number of values to generate.
constraints: num must be one of int32, int64

axis.description: Axis along which the operation is performed (can be specified to non-zero only when N-D tensors are provided).

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `start`.
